subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild authorization accept channel-name globs, and must they use explicit syntax gated by the mutable-name safety setting?
rationale: Implementation is bounded, but choosing a public authorization grammar and its interaction with mutable Discord names requires product and security policy judgment.

options.title: Explicit gated patterns
options.body: Add a dedicated pattern form enabled only with mutable-name matching, while exact IDs and direct entries retain precedence.

options.title: Automatic map-key globs
options.body: Interpret wildcard characters in existing channel-map keys automatically, simplifying configuration but changing existing key semantics.

options.title: Keep exact matching
options.body: Retain ID and exact-key authorization and direct dynamic workflows toward category inheritance or explicit channel-management flows.

recommendation.title: Explicit gated patterns
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated pattern form enabled only with mutable-name matching, while exact IDs and direct entries retain precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced or recently maintained the shared matching surface and supplied the strongest item-specific direction in the discussion.
